orientation: All claims extracted from the Spark Artifact. Prime Agent Artifacts share a common skeleton — Genesis and Operational Primitives, a Liquidity Layer or allocation surface, Root Edit governance, and Omni Documents — so the most informative way to read Spark is against its siblings. Where it diverges from the template, the divergence is the claim.
